about.metaDescription: Learn about Nguyen Duong Trung Hieu Co., Ltd. — 11 years of backpack and bag manufacturing experience in Tay Ninh, Vietnam
about.historyContent: Nguyen Duong Trung Hieu Co., Ltd. was established in 2015 in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, driven by a passion for craftsmanship and a commitment to producing high-quality backpacks and bags. Over more than 11 years of growth, we have become a trusted manufacturing partner for numerous domestic and international brands.
about.visionContent: To become a leading backpack and bag manufacturing facility in the region, recognized by domestic and international brands for consistent quality, on-time delivery, and professional service.
about.missionContent: To provide comprehensive, flexible, and reliable manufacturing solutions — from pattern making and sample development to mass production — enabling our clients to bring their design concepts to life with optimized costs and export-standard quality.
about.certificationNote: Quality certifications will be updated when available

services.metaDescription: Professional backpack and bag CMT manufacturing, pattern making, and sample development in Tay Ninh — Nguyen Duong Trung Hieu Co., Ltd.
services.heroSubtitle: From pattern to finished product — we support you at every stage of production
services.service1Description: Full-package Cut-Make-Trim (CMT) service using client-supplied materials. Ideal for large-volume orders requiring consistent quality standards.
services.service2Description: Professional pattern making and sample sewing services based on client designs or product samples. Ensuring accurate structure, proportions, and technical specifications before mass production.
services.service3Description: Custom logo printing and embroidery services upon client request. Contact us for detailed consultation.
services.processSubtitle: 6 straightforward steps — from concept to finished product
services.step1Description: Client submits design specifications, technical requirements, and materials (or requests our material sourcing consultation).
services.step2Description: We produce technical patterns, sew prototype samples, and provide a detailed quotation for client review.
services.step3Description: Both parties confirm sample approval and execute a manufacturing contract or purchase order.
services.step4Description: Full-scale CMT production is organized according to schedule — cutting, sewing, and finishing.
services.step5Description: Comprehensive product inspection before packaging, ensuring every unit meets agreed quality standards.
services.step6Description: Goods are delivered according to the method and destination specified in the contract.
services.ctaContent: Contact us today for a free consultation and receive a quotation within 24 business hours.
